asset.Name: Aircraft Weapons +25%
asset.Description:
Every Xenonaut aircraft weapon deals 25% more damage: cannons, missiles, torpedoes and lances, all tiers. UFO weapons are unchanged.

DAMAGE PER HIT (average)
- Cannons: 5 / 7.5 / 12.5 / 31.25 (was 4 / 6 / 10 / 25)
- Missiles: 25 / 35 / 50 / 62.5 (was 20 / 28 / 40 / 50)
- Torpedoes: 56.25 / 85 / 112.5 / 175 (was 45 / 68 / 90 / 140)
- Lances: 18.75 / 18.75 / 50 (was 15 / 15 / 40)

Armour destruction, range, reload time and ammo are unchanged.

COMPATIBILITY
- Replaces the templates of the Xenonaut aircraft weapons: do not use together with any mod that edits the same files.
- Works with Better Aircraft, Better Base and Finance x3.
